original.identity: three solid root levels reverse direction toward a middle-left cache; a cheap outer fall reaches a different lower exit without that cache

play_contract.alternative: Full-held normal jumps cross the attached thorn patches. Optional opposite fruit/recoil approaches are not required passwords.
play_contract.counterexample: A fast outside descent is allowed but must not receive the middle-left cache. Verify real body clearance below the middle root and actual reward/OR settlement separately.
play_contract.decision: Take the inner thorn crossing for the cache and leave through the lower-left mouth, or decline it and use the outer-right fall to the lower-right destination.
play_contract.observe: The right upper opening leads to a broad middle root; the valuable cache is on its opposite left side, above another left opening.
play_contract.recovery: Three broad real roots catch each descent; the bottom basin joins the world's root network, with no external return ladder.

outer_fast_drop.input_contract: walk outside the solid middle root; wait for the actual full body to clear its underside, then steer inward to the lower receiver
